title: THE PROMPTS ARE 60 PERCENT SIZE
why: His note of 2026-10-14: the press E to loot text is way too big. Every prompt in the world (the keycap and its words over a crate, a door, a body, the seal, an extraction ring) now draws at 60 percent of its old size: the plate, the keycap, the words and the second line shrink together about their own place, so the prompt stays where it was. It still grows with the screen like the rest of the HUD, so at 4K it is just as legible.
now: The press E prompts over crates, doors and bodies are now 60 percent of their old size.
